facts.command_line: bash -lc for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do systemctl enable --now auditd && systemctl is-active --quiet auditd && break; sleep 5; done
bash -lc sleep 20; { date -u; auditctl -l; chronyc tracking; } > /var/log/argus-sensor-check.txt 2>&1 || true
logger -s -p user.info -t cloud-init -- -----BEGIN SSH HOST KEY FINGERPRINTS-----
logger -s -p user.info -t cloud-init -- -----END SSH HOST KEY FINGERPRINTS-----
awk -F: BEGIN{ret=1} /^gpg-agent:/{if ($5 == "1") { ret=0; exit 0 } } END {exit ret}
